measures.id: Lea County Defense Fund Gross Receipts Tax
measures.title: Lea County Defense Fund Gross Receipts Tax
measures.summary: Asks whether Lea County should impose a county gross receipts tax of 0.01% (one-hundredth of one percent). The revenue would go to a defense fund to protect and defend against what the ballot calls unconstitutional state government overreach, including actions that infringe on the right to keep and bear arms under the U.S. and New Mexico constitutions.
measures.yesMeans: Lea County would impose a 0.01% county gross receipts tax to fund this defense fund.
measures.noMeans: Lea County would not impose this 0.01% gross receipts tax.
